attributes.title: TNP 2027 Pharmacology Conference + AI / PMH Pre Conference
attributes.venue: Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort & Spa
attributes.summary:
Texas Nurse Practitioners holds its 2027 Pharmacology Conference at the Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort & Spa in San Antonio. The TNP calendar lists it for April 22 to 24, but parts of the conference page still mention mid-April check-in, so confirm the dates with TNP before booking travel. Thursday is a pre-conference day with a choice of psychiatric and mental health or artificial intelligence tracks.

TNP says the full program offers up to 15 hours of CE and is planned to cover the Texas requirements for pharmacology, ethics and geriatrics. The full Thursday-to-Saturday package costs $505 for members and $705 for nonmembers through April 15, then $50 more. Single days and two-day packages are also sold. The page also mentions a $50 discount for registrations received by January 31.

The room rate is $249 a night with the resort fee waived, available through March 31, 2027.
